description: Wire the FEAT-003 pure helpers into the React UI and i18n layer: show each game's start time in the viewer's local timezone (or a localized 'Time TBD'), render a 'Today's / Tomorrow's games' section with a countdown for upcoming games, and offer a .ics download for timed games. Add EN/JA strings for all new labels. Add/extend Playwright e2e to prove the behaviors deterministically. Depends on FEAT-002 (shared startTime/timeTbd fields) and FEAT-003 (gameTime/upcomingGames/ics helpers).
steps: In frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts, add new MessageKey entries to the union and provide EN + JA strings for all of: a 'Time TBD' label (EN 'Time TBD' / JA '時刻未定'), the today/tomorrow section heading and the 'Today'/'Tomorrow' bucket labels, a countdown template (e.g. EN 'Starts in {days}d {hours}h {minutes}m' / JA 'あと {days}日 {hours}時間 {minutes}分'), an 'Add to calendar' / '.ics' button label (EN 'Add to calendar' / JA 'カレンダーに追加'), and any aria-labels needed. Use the existing dotted-key convention (e.g. 'gametime.tbd', 'upcoming.title', 'upcoming.today', 'upcoming.tomorrow', 'upcoming.countdown', 'ics.add'). Keep EN and JA key sets identical (the i18n index.test.ts / parity test must stay green).

In frontend/src/components/SeriesCard.tsx, in the per-game list row, render the localized start time using formatStartTime(game.startTime, { lang, timeZone: resolvedTimeZone, timeTbd: game.timeTbd, tbdLabel: t('gametime.tbd') }). Resolve the browser timezone once via Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone (fall back to 'UTC' if unavailable). For a timed game (startTime present, not timeTbd), render an 'Add to calendar' control that builds the .ics via buildIcs(...) and triggers a client-side download (Blob + object URL, text/calendar). For a timeTbd game, omit or disable the .ics control. Localize the button label. Do not break the existing collapsed games toggle, scores, or keyboard model.

In frontend/src/pages/SeriesDetailPage.tsx DetailGame, also render the localized local start time (or 'Time TBD') next to each game, reusing formatStartTime with the resolved timezone. Keep existing scores/winner rendering intact.

In frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx, add a 'Today's / Tomorrow's games' section (a new component, e.g. frontend/src/components/UpcomingGames.tsx) mounted in the ready+bracketStarted branch. Feed it selectUpcomingGames(bracket, now, resolvedTimeZone) using the already-tracked injectable `now` state. For each upcoming game show the matchup (teamName helpers), its localized local start time, and a countdown built from countdownParts + the countdown i18n template. The section must render nothing/empty-safely when there are no upcoming games (e.g. results-only seasons or all-TBD) and must not throw. Make `now` and timezone injectable (props with sensible defaults) so the component is unit-testable.

Add a colocated React test (e.g. frontend/src/components/UpcomingGames.test.tsx and/or an addition to SeriesCard.test.tsx) rendering with a fixed `now`, fixed timeZone prop, and a bracket containing one timed upcoming game and one timeTbd game: assert the timed game shows a localized local time and an enabled 'Add to calendar' control, the timeTbd game shows the 'Time TBD' label and no/disabled calendar control, and the today/tomorrow section lists the upcoming game. Use the existing render helpers/providers (I18nProvider) from frontend/src/test and fixtures.

Update frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts: add startTime (full ISO UTC) + timeTbd to at least one game in SAMPLE_2026_BRACKET's games (give the FINAL ALCS games real start times) and add a scheduled/in_progress series with an upcoming timed game AND a timeTbd game so the e2e can assert all three behaviors deterministically. Keep existing ids/semantics the other specs rely on.

Add or extend a Playwright spec (e.g. frontend/e2e/game-times.spec.ts) that stubs the 2026 bracket and asserts: (a) a game row shows a localized local-time string (or the 'Time TBD' label for the TBD game); (b) the Today's/Tomorrow's games section renders for the bracket with an upcoming game; (c) the 'Add to calendar' affordance appears for a timed game and is absent/disabled for the TBD game. Drive deterministically (the stub provides fixed startTimes); avoid asserting an exact clock value that depends on the runner tz by matching the localized label/affordance presence and a time-ish pattern. Do NOT make live calls.
Run frontend unit tests, the full build, and the e2e suite.
acceptance_criteria: Each game renders its start time converted to the viewer's local timezone via Intl.DateTimeFormat with EN/JA formatting, and timeTbd/undefined games render a localized 'Time TBD'/'時刻未定' instead of a bogus time (criteria 2 + 3).
A 'Today's / Tomorrow's games' section renders upcoming games with a countdown and safely renders nothing when there are no upcoming games.
A .ics 'Add to calendar' download affordance appears for timed games and is omitted/disabled for TBD-time games; the downloaded content is a valid VEVENT built by buildIcs.
New EN and JA strings are added with identical key sets; the i18n parity test and existing component tests stay green.
`npm test -w @mlb/frontend` and `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend` pass, including the new assertions for localized time, the today/tomorrow section, and the .ics affordance.
`npm run build` succeeds; existing date-based rendering and the keyboard/toggle model are unregressed.
findings: Wired FEAT-003 helpers into the UI. Added 10 i18n keys (gametime.tbd/startLabel, ics.add/ariaLabel, upcoming.title/region/today/tomorrow/countdown/vs) in EN+JA with identical key sets (parity test green). Added resolveTimeZone() to gameTime.ts (Intl.DateTimeFormat resolved zone with UTC fallback) so SeriesCard and SeriesDetailPage resolve the zone the same way. SeriesCard GameRow renders localized local time per game and an 'Add to calendar' button for timed games only (client-side Blob/object-URL .ics download, guarded no-op in jsdom); omitted for timeTbd games. SeriesDetailPage DetailGame shows the local time/Time-TBD. New UpcomingGames component mounted on HomePage in the ready+bracketStarted branch, fed the existing injectable `now` plus an injectable timeZone prop; returns null when there are no upcoming games (results-only/all-TBD). Tests: added UpcomingGames.test.tsx (fixed now+UTC) and a SeriesCard timed/TBD case; e2e fixtures got startTimes on the FINAL ALCS games + a new stubBracket2026WithGameTimes that APPENDS an in-progress NLCS with a now-relative timed game and a TBD game (kept out of the shared SAMPLE_2026_BRACKET so keyboard.spec's fixed 3-card layout stays intact); added game-times.spec.ts (4 tests incl. a real download assertion). Verified: npm run build OK, npm test (shared 34 / backend 94 / frontend 120 / infra 8) all green, npm run test:e2e 38 passed, npm run synth OK. Did NOT touch specs/READMEs (that is FEAT-005's scope).
